Creme De Banane
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:40pm

Ingredients




2 medium-sized bananas, peeled
1 teaspoon vanilla extract or a 2" length of vanilla bean
1 cup simple syrup
3 cups vodka

Preparation

1 Mash the bananas, and add the vanilla and cooled syrup to the vodka. 2 Shake gently, steep for 1 week. 3 Strain and filter. 4 Drink immediately, or age 2-3 months for best results.
